name: Protagonist
source:
You open your eyes one evening and find yourself stuck on the wall of an artist’s studio. You’re… a painting? Or— maybe you’re the person inside the frame? The only way you might find the truth is with your voice. But the only person who can hear you is…

[From [url=https://blank-house.itch.io/that-which-surrounds]itch.io[/url]]
